measurement_policy.rule: A target is never displayed as an achieved figure. Null means unmeasured and must render as unmeasured.

calibration.dashboard_figures_policy: Only values calculated by the current run or loaded from a versioned measurement artefact may be displayed as measurements.
calibration.final_submission_figures_policy: Every figure must be labelled as configured, unmeasured, or measured with its method and version.
